title: notify click-through default: four texts say a before-create run links to its record, but that run has no record id yet
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTqqeHSwZYJmApbDCa

Filing gate ①: shipped text that is false for one case, at named locations. The contract review of PR #30742 (card #30689, record 6673599244) found it and owed it as one card over every surface that carries the wording. That PR lands without it, because fixing the spec alone would open a second dialect against the runtime's wording source. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage routes it. Suggested-grade: p3 · text only, the runtime is right.

## Observed (`origin/main` `e8dc4833b`)

The notify click-through default is enumerated as "a run started by a record (a record change other than a delete, a time-relative sweep, an action on a record) links to that record". A `beforeInsert` run (`record-before-create`, or the insert leg of `record-before-write`) is a record change other than a delete. It has no record id yet:

- `packages/triggers/trigger-record-change/src/record-change-trigger.ts` :477-485. On that leg there is no after-row and no `previous`, so `record` is the write's input. That input carries an `id` only when the caller wrote one. The driver issues the id at the write, after the hook (`packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts` :845; `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts` :3269 "the driver has not issued an id yet").
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts` :155-159. `triggerRecordOf` needs both `context.object` and `context.record.id`, so it answers nothing and the notification links nowhere.

These texts say it links:

1. `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts` is the wording source:
   - the `defaultClickThroughOf` docblock :174-176 ("a record-change run");
   - the `sourceObject` / `sourceId` config descriptions :885 and :889.
2. `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`, as PR #30742 writes it: the `NotifyConfigSchema` docblock bullet (:648 at that PR's head) and the `sourceObject` / `sourceId` describes (:763, :772).
3. `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` :353-355, as PR #30682 (card #30254) writes it.
4. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` :125, as PR #30682 writes it: "trigger record (not on delete), if any".

On `main` today, 3 and 4 say nothing about the default.

The outcome is a notification with no link, not a dead link. The cost is that an author, or an AI, leaves out the pair on a before-create notify and expects a link that never comes.

## Wanted

- **One PR.** It changes all four texts to say "a record change other than a delete or a before-create", or to another wording that all four share. It regenerates `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx`.
- **A pin.** A notify on a `beforeInsert` run that writes no pair writes no `source_object` / `source_id`.
- **One more clause the review observed.** `notify-node.ts` :709 says "or to `null` to leave it unset", and flows.mdx :352 says "`null` leaves the key unset". Both read as if a `null` envelope were left out. It is a written key, so the half pair is dropped rather than defaulted.
- No schema shape changes: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Sequencing: texts 3 and 4 exist only once PR #30682 merges, so this card waits for that merge. Alternatively, PR #30682 can take the wording before it lands, if its seat prefers.

Reader: the lane triage routes it to. If another lane carries the spec hunk, it needs `domain:spec` consent, which this seat gives on its mailbox PR #30558. Links: #30689, PR #30742, #30254, PR #30682, #30121, PR #30252.

Dedupe (is:issue):
- `notify before-create click-through` → 4 hits, all QA runs or seat posts.
- `notify "other than a delete"` → 3 hits: #30254, #30689 and #15832 (closed, another subject).
- `notify "before-create" link` → 61 hits. Nearest: #25990 and #29139 (closed, other subjects).

None is about the before-create case. **New.**
